name: Erosion
source:
Imagine the devil gets you transported in another world, and you have to "defeat" the previous Heroes from currently corrupting the world; all these while being unable to increase your magical or physical strength, but rather... your lewd powers?

You might think that such powers can be awesome, right? But how are they going to help you defeat those all-mighty heroes who have everything?

Are you going to ask for help? Are you going to try get stronger? Or do you have another idea...?

Erosion Project is an Adventure 2D Adult Fantasy RPG combined with Card Game - Strategic elements, which will challenge the player to find the right cards and the right strategy to effectively defeat the enemies before the battle starts.

[From [url=https://trash-gods.itch.io/erosion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
想像一下，惡魔把你傳送到了異世界，而你必須「擊敗」那些曾經的英雄——他們如今正讓這個世界日漸腐敗。你無法提升魔力或體能，能增強的反而是……你的色慾之力？

這種力量聽起來似乎很厲害，對吧？可面對擁有一切的強大英雄，它究竟能幫你取勝嗎？

你會向別人求助嗎？會想辦法變強嗎？還是另有打算……？

《侵蝕計畫》是一款成人向奇幻冒險遊戲，結合了2D角色扮演與卡牌策略元素。你必須在戰鬥開始前挑選合適的卡牌、制定正確策略，才能有效擊敗敵人。

[來源：[url=https://trash-gods.itch.io/erosion]Itch.io[/url]]
